meta.title: SupoClip Creator Program: Get Pro Free for Making Videos
meta.description: Make Shorts, Reels, TikToks or videos about SupoClip and get SupoClip Pro for free. Your audience gets 20% off their first 3 months with your code.

hero.title: Make videos about SupoClip. Get Pro for free.
hero.body: Posting Shorts, Reels or TikToks about clipping, podcasting or creator tools? Get your own code. Your audience saves on SupoClip, and you get Pro while you're in the program.

video.name: How the SupoClip creator program works
video.description: Apply, pick your code, and your audience gets 20% off their first 3 months. Approved creators get SupoClip Pro for free.
video.aria: Creator program explainer: apply, pick your code, and your audience gets 20% off their first 3 months

offer.heading: What everyone gets
offer.youDetail: Pro is normally ${price}/month and includes {limit} hours of video a month. Approved creators get it for free for as long as they're in the program.
offer.youDetailNoLimit: Pro is normally ${price}/month. Approved creators get it for free for as long as they're in the program.
offer.audienceDetail: For their first 3 months on any plan. It works through your link or by typing your code at checkout.

apply.title: Apply
apply.detail: Tell us where you post and pick your code, like MAYA. It takes two minutes.

review.title: We review
review.detail: Every application is reviewed by hand. You get an email either way.

share.title: Share
share.detail: Put your link in your bio or say your code in your videos. Your account gets Pro right away.

rules.heading: The rules
rules.sponsored: Mark sponsored posts as such, for example with #ad.
rules.ads: Don't run ads on the SupoClip name or post your code on coupon or deal sites.
rules.end: We can end the program or remove a creator at any time.

cash.question: Do I get paid in cash?
cash.answer: Not right now. Approved creators get SupoClip Pro (normally ${price}/month) for free while they're in the program.

followers.question: Is there a minimum number of followers?
followers.answer: No. We look at what you post, not just how many people follow you. Small creators who already make videos about SupoClip are a great fit.

audience.question: What does my audience get?
audience.answer: Anyone who signs up through your link or enters your code at checkout gets 20% off their first 3 months. On the web it works on any plan. On iPhone it applies to Pro: people tap “Have a creator code?” in the app or open your iPhone link.

code.question: Can I pick my own code?
code.answer: Yes. Codes are 3 to 20 letters, numbers or hyphens, and each one can only belong to one creator. The form tells you right away if yours is available.

declined.question: What happens if my application is declined?
declined.answer: You'll get an email, with a note from us when there's something specific. You can apply again after 30 days.

account.question: Do I need a SupoClip account?
account.answer: Yes. The program is tied to your account, so you'll create a free one (or sign in) before applying.

cta.title: Already posting about SupoClip?
cta.body: Apply with a link to your profile and pick your code. If you've made a video about SupoClip, include it.
